artifacts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Age of Fronts game asset, painted realistic 2D strategy icon, genuine transparent alpha.
Style: realistic hand-painted finish matching the supplied reference, muted olive-drab, grey industrial metal, restrained warm material highlights, subtle weathering, sharp readable outline. No cartoon cel shading or technical blueprint.
Camera: STRICT TOP DOWN orthographic view. No isometric tilt, perspective, angled camera or large visible side elevation.
Constraints: ONE complete centered subject only, generous transparent margin, no text, symbols, logos, numbering, people or watermark. The background outside the asset is genuinely transparent, not white, black or painted checkerboard.
Input image 1 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY for industrial materials, weathering, rooftops, overhead geometry and ground footprint. Do not copy the runway or hangars.
Primary request: a Modern Age military missile silo facility, square 1254 x 1254 PNG.
Subject: a large clearly readable circular reinforced olive-grey steel silo hatch occupying the center of a substantial pale concrete launch pad, inset flush to ground, with heavy panel seams, a compact service mechanism housing along one edge and concentric concrete edging. A short service road connects the pad to one low flat-roof operations bunker and a small utility shed. Muted grass and gravel shoulders form a coherent bounded facility footprint. Restrained perimeter security fence, controlled service-road entrance, a few olive supply containers outside the launch pad.
Composition: perfectly vertical 90-degree aerial plan, circular hatch remains circular, roof plans visible without front walls. Silo lid closed. Compact but believable military site, recognizable circular missile hatch as the dominant icon silhouette, all objects inside a comfortable transparent border.
Avoid: missile launching, fire, smoke, cutaway, internal mechanism schematic, technical dimensions, runway, decorative nuclear logos, giant towers or obvious front facades.
